day_shape: 52 items: Iran's military threatens 'sustained' response to any renewed US action and keeps Strait of Hormuz closed pending conditions, CENTCOM says 109 vessels redirected, IDF kills Nukhba commander plus two Oct.7 infiltrators in Gaza, heavy IRIB/Defa Press volume, nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Hormuz closure and US-Iran threats
threads.summary: Iran's central military command said it had received information the US was preparing renewed action and warned of a 'sustained' response, while Tehran said the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until conditions are met. CENTCOM said it had redirected 109 commercial vessels as of 20 September, and Iran's parliament approved articles of a Hormuz security plan mandating use of the name 'Persian Gulf' in all treaties.

threads.label: IDF Gaza and West Bank operations
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet said strikes in Gaza killed Nukhba commander Basir Al-Barsh and two Hamas members who infiltrated Israel on 7 October 2023, Yahya Hamdouna and Muhammad Rafaei. Separately, IDF soldiers shot a suspect who attempted a ramming attack in Ganim and apprehended a gunman after a shooting attack in Neve Tzuf.

threads.label: Iran regime defiance messaging
threads.summary: Defa Press quoted President Pezeshkian telling cabinet Iran will 'in no way back down to bullying and coercion' and that production must not stop, while the army ground force commander said border deterrence was holding. Defa Press also claimed an Israeli Orbiter reconnaissance drone was shot down over the Strait of Hormuz at 18:30.

threads.label: Rallies, defections and internal crackdown
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported hundreds of thousands attended a regime-organised Tehran rally, the largest since the US and Israeli strikes, while Reza Pahlavi claimed Iran had entered an 'active defection' phase. Iran International reported a Basij-linked cultural network helped Revolutionary Guards intelligence identify January protesters, and Tehran's prosecutor announced the sealing of a French embassy-linked language centre.

threads.label: Regional flashpoints: Yemen, Lebanon, Erbil
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press reported Israeli air strikes on Nabatiyeh in southern Lebanon and an explosion in Erbil, while a Jerusalem Post US security advisory and Ansarallah statements referenced the ongoing Houthi–Saudi exchange. Qatar's prime minister publicly demanded Israel honour its Gaza commitments, calling its conduct 'reckless'.

Hasan Ghasghavi, spokesman for the National Security and Foreign Policy Committee of the Islamic Consultative Assembly, said: In today's afternoon session of the National Security and Foreign Policy Committee, Article 10 of the strategic action plan for ensuring security and development of the Strait of Hormuz was approved. Article 12 of the plan was also approved today, and based on it, the full name "Persian Gulf" must be included in all negotiations, treaties, agreements, publications and related documents, as well as discussions related to vessels and fleets; that is, the full name "Persian Gulf" must be used.

events.title_en: Pezeshkian: We will in no way back down to bullying and coercion. The President said: Whilst we do not seek war and conflict, and we know it harms our own people and indeed the world, we will in no way back down to bullying and coercion. According to religious teachings, a peace to which your enemy invites you should not be rejected, for it contains security and peace; however, one must not be heedless of the enemy's cunning and scheming, for peace may be a tool for striking a blow. For this reason, we will proceed with wisdom and prudence. We have no good faith in the enemy, and should we make a covenant, we will stand honourably by it.

events.title_en: Centre affiliated with French Embassy in Tehran sealed. The Tehran Prosecutor's Office announced: In continuation of France's unlawful activities and violations of diplomatic protocol, an unlawful centre affiliated with that embassy was operating under the guise of foreign language instruction. Despite multiple warnings from legal authorities to obtain operating permits based on the country's laws and regulations, unfortunately this centre refused and in effect disrespected the country's laws. On this basis and by order of the Tehran Prosecutor's Office, the unlawful centre affiliated with the French Embassy in Tehran (referred to as CLF) which has been operating under the guise of language instruction in recent years has been sealed.
